canalizacao.title: Plumbing
canalizacao.tagline: Water networks in PPR, copper and PVC.
canalizacao.alt: PPR piping installed by VART Soluções
canalizacao.description: Installation, replacement and repair of pipework, connections, valves and fittings. Every job starts by understanding the state of the network and ends with checked connections and tested operation.
bullets: Hot and cold water networks (PPR, PVC, copper)
New installations and replacement of old pipework
Sewer and drainage networks in PVC

instalacao-de-eletrobomba.title: Electric pump installation
instalacao-de-eletrobomba.tagline: Assembly, start-up and testing of the pumping system.
instalacao-de-eletrobomba.alt: Electric pump assembly on a VART Soluções job
instalacao-de-eletrobomba.description: Installation of electric pumps based on an analysis of the whole set-up — intake, suction, discharge, valves, controls and power supply — so that the pump works well and stays protected.
bullets: Assembly of the pump and the suction and discharge pipework
Fitting of foot valves and check valves
Fixing of the pipework and protection against water hammer
Start-up and operating test
checks: Water source and quality: free of solids, fibres or oils, and whether an inlet filter is needed
Foot valve submerged and sized to suit the suction
Check valve on the discharge, next to the pump, and intermediate ones where the height difference is large
Pipework fixing, to avoid stress on the pump ports and water hammer
Power supply and controls: electrical connections only by a qualified professional
At start-up: pressure, noise, vibration, heating and absence of leaks
instalacao-de-eletrobomba.limits: Pump sizing depends on the installation data and is confirmed on site. Work on the electrical panel or on equipment that requires an authorised technician is coordinated with the qualified professional.

manutencao-preventiva-de-eletrobombas.title: Preventive maintenance of electric pumps
manutencao-preventiva-de-eletrobombas.tagline: Inspections to spot wear before a breakdown.
manutencao-preventiva-de-eletrobombas.alt: Electric pump maintenance carried out by VART Soluções
manutencao-preventiva-de-eletrobombas.description: An inspection plan adapted to the installation and its use, to spot wear and faults before the pump stops. The frequency of visits is defined after an assessment on site.
bullets: Periodic inspection of automatic operation
Check of the pressure switch and start-up cycles
Check of foot valves and check valves
Cleaning of water filters
Record of the work and recommendations to the client
checks: Automatic pump operation: start and stop
Watertightness of the foot valve
Pressure switch and pressurisation float, where fitted
Dry-run protection, where fitted
Water filters and check valves
Noise, vibration, heating and leaks
Condition of switches, relays and fuses, by a qualified professional
manutencao-preventiva-de-eletrobombas.limits: The frequency of visits and the actions included depend on the equipment, its use and the manufacturer's instructions, and are agreed in writing in the quote.

piscinas.alt: Pool pump installed by VART Soluções
piscinas.description: Installation and maintenance of pool circulation and filtration systems: pumps, filters and pipework.
bullets: Assembly of pumps and filtration systems
Correction of existing installations
Periodic maintenance

deteccao-de-fugas.title: Leak detection
deteccao-de-fugas.alt: Leak test on a hydraulic installation carried out by VART Soluções
deteccao-de-fugas.description: Pressure and watertightness tests to identify the probable origin of a leak before choosing the repair method. When a wall or floor has to be opened, we explain it to the client first.
bullets: Watertightness test on new and existing networks
Inspection and location of the probable origin of the leak
Repair and watertightness check

manutencao.title: Technical maintenance
manutencao.tagline: Preventive and corrective work for installations and equipment.
manutencao.alt: Electric pump maintenance carried out by VART Soluções
manutencao.description: Inspections and scheduled actions to reduce failures and extend the life of hydraulic installations and equipment, with intervention on breakdowns when they occur.
bullets: Scheduled preventive maintenance
Repair of faults in pumps and networks
Recommendations to the client after each intervention

eletricidade.alt: Electrical conductor wiring on a VART Soluções job
eletricidade.description: Pulling and connecting conductors on site, with a prior assessment on location, organised execution and a final check of the work done.
bullets: Pulling and connecting conductors
Assessment on site before the quote
Final check of the work carried out

ladrilho.alt: Tile laying carried out by VART Soluções
ladrilho.description: Tile laying on site, including stairs and bathrooms, with attention to alignment and the final finish.
bullets: Laying on stairs and in bathrooms
Quote with a defined scope and materials
Cleaning and handover of the finished area

teto-falso.title: False ceilings
teto-falso.tagline: False ceilings built with a clean finish.
teto-falso.alt: False ceiling built by VART Soluções
teto-falso.description: False ceilings built with a clean finish, with the quote and scope defined before the job.
bullets: Assessment on site before the quote
Organised execution and a clean area at the end

termo-acumuladores.title: Storage water heaters
termo-acumuladores.alt: Graphic card for the Storage water heaters service (brand illustration, not a photograph of a job)
termo-acumuladores.description: Installation, replacement, inspection and maintenance of storage water heaters, following the manufacturer's instructions and paying attention to the hydraulic connections and safety devices.
bullets: Installation and replacement of storage water heaters
Fitting of the hydraulic safety group
Repair of leaks and valves
Periodic maintenance according to the manufacturer
checks: Model, capacity and site conditions: support, space and accessibility
Safety group: shut-off valve, safety valve, expansion vessel, non-return valve and pressure-reducing valve
Safety valve discharge unobstructed, pointing downwards and connected to a drain
Safety valve operation, using the test lever
Condition of the protective anode, on models that have one, according to the manufacturer
Mains pressure at the equipment inlet
Watertightness of the hydraulic connections
termo-acumuladores.limits: Any work is done with the power supply switched off, and the electrical part only by a qualified professional. The safety valve discharge must never be blocked; dripping during heating can be normal. For equipment under warranty, the manufacturer's conditions apply.

montagem-de-filtros.title: Filter installation and maintenance
montagem-de-filtros.tagline: Pool filters: installation, start-up and maintenance.
montagem-de-filtros.alt: Graphic card for the Filter installation and maintenance service (brand illustration, not a photograph of a job)
montagem-de-filtros.description: Installation of pool filters with pump, multiport valve and pipework, and maintenance of the filtration set, so that the water circulates and is filtered as the equipment intends.
bullets: Installing the filter on a stable, level base
Connecting the pump, the multiport valve and the return
Loading sand, where applicable
Start-up and checking the pressure on the gauge
Maintenance and replacement of components
checks: Filter base stable, solid and level
Non-return valve, if the filter sits above the water level
Multiport valve: filter, backwash, rinse, recirculate, waste and closed
Valve operated only with the pump switched off
Sand placed before the pipes are connected to the valve
Initial pressure with a clean filter, recorded as a reference
Watertightness of the connections and pump operation
montagem-de-filtros.limits: Maximum working pressure and sand load follow the filter manufacturer's instructions. Electrical connections of pool equipment are made by a qualified professional.

pintura.title: Painting
pintura.alt: Graphic card for the Painting service (brand illustration, not a photograph of a job)
pintura.description: Painting with a clean finish, protection of the work area and a quote with a scope defined before the job.
bullets: Assessment on site before the quote
Protection of the work area
Clean area and handover at the end
checks: Condition of the surfaces and need for preparation
Materials suited to the type of surface
Protection of floors, furniture and circulation areas
pintura.limits: The type of paint, the number of coats and the timescale depend on the assessment on site and are defined in the quote.
